facts.fact: Spiked Media reports Zimbabwe's ICT ministry hosted in Harare a three-day workshop on data policy harmonisation for Southern African governments, co-organised by Smart Africa Alliance, UNESCO and the World Bank; the article gives no day for the event and is dated 2026-08-16.
Spiked Media reports Zimbabwe's ICT minister currently chairs Smart Africa's Council of ICT Ministers; no date for taking the chair is given, so the article's publication date is used.
facts.system: Smart Africa Council of ICT Ministers

facts.fact: Spiked Media states Smart Africa is an alliance of 42 member states and that Zimbabwe was the 26th to join; the date of joining is not given, so the publication date is used.
